The coal must be extracted with a pick. The only known deposits are on the north cliff face near the [[quarry]], in the [[Forest near the river|forest]] northwest of the [[graveyard]] and south of the [[wheat farm]]. It can also be obtained via a [[zombie ore mine]].

The southern deposit is unreachable, due to it being in the [[town]], yet the icon is still given to mine when approached from above.

To access the northern area, you must rebuild the [[stone bridge]] west of the [[graveyard]], and the [[Blockage|debris that blocks the road]] will have to be cleared. 

A second possibility is to clear the [[blockage]] north of the [[apiary]] and use the [[river#Small Island|footbridge]] to cross the [[river]].

Each time you mine the deposit you will get between 20 and 30 coal. It can be used as a fuel source in an oven or melted into graphite in a furnace.
